'''OTSD Booster Draft''' is a Star Wars CCG booster-draft format played with the [[Official Tournament Sealed Deck]]: players draft the Premiere and A New Hope boosters from the box and keep their own 18 premium cards. [[Decipher]] published it as a sanctioned format by 1999.<ref name="otsdbd99">[http://decipher.com/starwars/tournaments/resources/otsdboosterformat.html Rules – Star Wars CCG sanctioned OTSD Booster Draft], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990901012813/http://decipher.com/starwars/tournaments/resources/otsdboosterformat.html Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' booster draft
* '''Defined by:''' Decipher (by 1999)
* '''Card pool:''' one Official Tournament Sealed Deck per player (4 Premiere boosters, 1 A New Hope booster, 18 premium cards); 40-card decks
* '''In use:''' 1999 –
* '''Also called:''' OTSD Booster Draft Format (Decipher, 2001)<ref name="res-sw">[http://tournaments.decipher.com/resources-sw.asp Star Wars Customizable Card Game Tournament Resources], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011116144130/http://tournaments.decipher.com/resources-sw.asp Internet Archive].</ref>
* '''GEMP:''' none

== Card pool ==
Decipher's rules:<ref name="otsdbd99" />
* '''Product:''' "Each player must start with 1 Official Tournament Sealed Deck."
* '''Seating:''' groups of 6 where possible, otherwise 4; the tournament director drafts a dummy hand to keep Light and Dark equal ("The tournament director should always draft in a group of 6 and draft competitively"). Sides are assigned at random and seated alternately (L-D-L-D-L-D).
* '''Drafting:''' starting with the Premiere boosters, each player opens a pack, takes one card for their own side and passes the rest left. "There is no defensive drafting - you may only take cards from your Side of the Force." No one picks up the next stack until everyone has picked; picked cards may not be looked at again. Directions switch after each pack. The A New Hope pack is drafted last ("Drafting should be done in the same order in which the expansions were released").
* '''Premiums:''' "The eighteen premium cards that are in the Official Tournament Sealed Deck are not drafted. Each player holds onto their own and may incorporate them into their deck."
* '''Deck building:''' 10 minutes to build a 40-card deck; unused cards may be swapped in between games, keeping 40 cards. "The tournament is then run using the regular Enhanced Format Sealed Deck tournament rules."

The rules gave a table of group sizes (8 players: 2 groups of 4; 9: a group of 4 and a group of 6 with a dummy player; 10: 4 + 6; 11: 2 groups of 6, one with a dummy; 12: 2 groups of 6; and so on).<ref name="otsdbd99" />

== History ==
The rules page was on Decipher's site by September 1999 and was republished unchanged on Decipher's 2001–2002 tournament site.<ref name="otsdbd99" /><ref name="otsdbd02">[http://tournaments.decipher.com/otsdboosterdraft-sw.asp Rules – Star Wars CCG Sanctioned OTSD Booster Draft], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020606153954/http://tournaments.decipher.com/otsdboosterdraft-sw.asp Internet Archive].</ref> At [[DecipherCon 1999]] the ''Star Trek'' CCG schedule held an OTSD Booster Draft (ST.23) on 13 and 14 November.<ref name="dc99-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule (Saturday)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026023004/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="dc99-sun">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule (Sunday)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026063736/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html Internet Archive].</ref>

The Players Committee's Alternate Format Tournament Guide keeps "OTSD Booster Draft" (one Official Tournament Sealed Deck; booster-draft rules; "The 18-card premium packs are opened as if the format were sealed, and only the booster packs are drafted") and adds a Jabba's Palace version, "JPOTSD Booster Draft".<ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
